previous_vsl_expansion.source: Installed segment_vsl used by canonical writer

selection.domain_scope: All installed NP caps crossed with the product of both physical meter seed neighborhoods; NUF measured from each seed before its fixed-target game. Unvisited seeds remain unknown. No directional service-sum shares.

candidates.target_source: Current actual-command forecast at decision entry; fixed for every seed and follower candidate in this decision

fast_np.bound_limit: Local observed secants do not bound all green/offset/VSL/meter combinations. No target may be excluded by these values.
fast_np.scope: 17-owner boundary_in + off_ramp - boundary_out - on_ramp accepted service. Full model and writer must validate each retargeted seed; no queue-only 450s service cap.
fast_np.observed_range_scope: Only evaluated seeds satisfying the fixed NUF band and model/writer constraints; no whole-domain limit.
fast_np.skip_rule: Unrestored cap/NUF within short budget remains unknown; advance to the next leader candidate. Model/command contract failure aborts.

decision_budget.scope_rule: Inclusive nested scopes; do not sum. Deadline checked between callbacks; an in-flight callback can overrun.

physical_response_cache.timing_scope: Endpoint/local scoring and serialization are nested within query wall/CPU; serialization may also nest within local scoring. Preparation copy/serialization nest within preparation. Avoided time is prior-query measured work, not measured total speedup
physical_response_cache.parallel_timing_scope: Parent query wall/CPU are local; endpoint/local-score CPU and wall are sums of completed worker tasks, not elapsed parallel wall. Submitted, completed, accepted and unknown failed endpoint counts remain separate.

selection.time_budget_scope: Single preparation/price/search/finalization deadline; cooperative callback overrun is reported
selection.ranking_scope: Pure final Omega J among validated observed follower responses; partial/null gaps are preserved; infeasible initializers do not prove leader-domain infeasibility

nuf_initialization.scope: Current actual-command forecast at decision entry; fixed for every seed and follower candidate in this decision

SC7.phase_gauge: p1 independent; p2+p4 prices sum to zero; p3 fixed zero

selected_price_field.phase_gauge: Serial: active phase price sum=0; concurrent_p1_p2: p1 independent and p2+p4 price sum=0; dead phases=0

model_constraint_coverage.claim_scope: implemented traffic-transition allocation and post-projection limits; control-domain feasibility is a caller obligation

joint_shared_response.per_owner_scope: Final-gap audit at the final incumbent; unvisited does not imply no search

search.scope: Producer search history at sweep incumbents; not the final-gap audit or a certificate

accepted_updates.selection_policy: Largest completely checked own-payoff improvement at the fixed sweep incumbent
